title: Unbounded comparison: full faithfulness and sums
statement: Let $k$ be a finite or algebraically closed field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $k$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the unbounded derived categories of ordinary module sheaves over the constant discrete ring $A$ on the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and the comparison geometric morphism $\nu_X$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Then its termwise inverse-image functor $\nu_X^*:D(X_{\mathrm{ét}},A)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ is exact and fully faithful and preserves arbitrary small direct sums.

source.place: Statement, consequence of the unbounded derived-unit isomorphism; proof sk-prop-pe-unbounded-classical-unit.proof.md

proof.text: Use the existing exact finite coefficient comparison and its canonical coefficient realization equivalence. The induced derived comparison is triangulated by the exact-functor instance.

Construct the canonical unbounded derived adjunction of comparisonUpperStar and right-derived comparisonLowerStar using mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. Replace the nilpotence exponent n by n+1 to meet the positive-exponent hypothesis of finiteClassicalUnboundedComparison. That existing theorem supplies classicality of the entire derived image and invertibility of the actual derived counit there; it retains the geometric finite-CD truncation argument.

The underived comparison is fully faithful, so reflects isomorphisms. For a derived morphism whose inverse image is invertible, use mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso in each integer degree to see that inverse image of its cohomology map is invertible. Reflect this to the original cohomology map; DerivedCategory.isIso_iff proves that the derived morphism is invertible.

At any K the left triangle identity says L(eta_K) followed by epsilon_(LK) is the identity. The second factor is invertible by the classical counit theorem and classicality of LK. Cancel it to prove L(eta_K) invertible, and reflect through derived L to prove eta_K invertible. Assemble the natural unit isomorphism and apply fullyFaithfulLOfIsIsoUnit.

Compose the fully faithful derived inverse image with the derived coefficient realization equivalence, transporting along mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The derived inverse image preserves each requested Discrete I colimit by its left adjunction; coefficient realization also preserves these colimits by equivalence. Transport preservation along the same canonical composition isomorphism.
